approval_gate.detail: ideas/004/HUMAN_APPROVED_PROBE exists (committed 3ecee0e, 2026-08-11T23:08:04Z). The contract YAML's human_approved flag was left false in that same commit; run.py gates on the committed marker file and this discrepancy is documented in run.py and README.md.

checks.name: syntax_compile
checks.reason: This sandbox denies python script execution without interactive approval, and the session is autonomous. python3 --version works; running scripts does not.

checks.name: smoke_run
checks.reason: Same sandbox restriction. The smoke mode is stdlib-only, needs no network or GPU, finishes in seconds, and is the first thing the human should run.
checks.expected_when_run: exit 0; outputs_smoke/ contains all seven contract-required files; summary.json has contract_satisfied=false, harness_checks all true, and 54 rows in per_sample.csv (3 executions x 18 heads).

checks.name: static_review_pair_selection
checks.detail: Hand-traced select_pair() on the synthetic table: 3 non-validation rows (2 train, 1 test) refused by the split guard; decoys for slice-count drift, ZSpacing drift, wrong kernel contrast (Br44f), and singleton scan all excluded; exactly one qualifying pair (valid_1_a_1|valid_1_a_2) selected by the deterministic sort-and-take-first rule. Smoke mode asserts each of these counts and exits 12 on any mismatch.

checks.name: static_review_contract_mapping
checks.detail: Each of the contract's seven invalidating_failures maps to a distinct exit code (3-9); the three executions (A, B, A-repeat) are hardcoded with no CLI knobs beyond --smoke, batch size 1, one seed (0), and the 45-GPU-minute cumulative cap is checked after every execution. Contract caps are re-read from probe_contract.yaml at startup and the run aborts (exit 2) if they differ from the frozen constants.

checks.name: static_review_required_outputs
checks.detail: Both modes write all seven required_outputs: resolved_config.json, per_sample.csv, summary.json, environment.txt, provenance.json, input_manifest.csv, run_log.txt. In real mode provenance.json (repo revision, checkpoint SHA-256, code commit, table hashes) is written before any inference; volume hashes are appended at download time, still before inference.

checks.name: static_review_split_guards
checks.detail: assert_validation_only() refuses any resource whose path or name indicates train or test split, and is applied to every hub download and both pair members; assert_pair_valid() additionally asserts A != B, same patient+scan, distinct reconstruction ids. No labels enter any endpoint; the validation labels CSV is read only because the released dataset class requires the file and for the head-name/order check.

checks.name: released_api_fidelity
checks.detail: Model construction (CTViT/CTCLIP constructor arguments, ImageLatentsClassifier 512->18, sigmoid readout, empty-string text tokens) and the 18 head names were transcribed from the official CT-CLIP repository (scripts/ct_lipro_inference.py, scripts/data_inference_nii.py, fetched 2026-08-11). Exact constructor/call signatures were summarized, not executed; if the released signatures differ, run.py fails with exit 5/7/9 and the driver must be corrected to match the released code, never the reverse. That failure would itself be a valid probe observation under invalidating_failures[2].

checks.name: expensive_compute
checks.detail: No downloads, no GPU work, no gated-data access performed at this stage, per the stage instructions.

next_actions_for_human: python3 run.py --smoke  (seconds; verifies the harness end to end)

python3 run.py  (the real probe: ~3 GB download, three executions, <45 GPU minutes)
